title: Request Stop
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Every time I press stop, the bus gets heavier.
first_visual: A red STOP button lit under a gloved thumb; an empty shelter in sodium rain ahead.

beats.visual: Thumb presses a lit STOP button; an empty shelter ahead.
beats.vo: Every time I press stop, the bus gets heavier.

beats.visual: Doors open at an empty stop; the bus dips.
beats.vo: Nobody gets on. But it sinks.

beats.visual: Another stop; a seat cushion dents.

beats.vo: 'Thanks for ringing for them, love. They can't reach the button now.'

beats.visual: Ivy looks round: every seat dented, breath fogging from empty seats.
Key moment: Ivy reaches for the button; a grey hand rests on her wrist; the bell dings by itself; she stands, and her seat stays dented.
beats.vo: My stop. Someone rang it for me.

ending: A cold hand settles on her wrist; the bell dings by itself. She stands; her seat stays dented. She is one of them now.

originality_review: Original. Not a ghost bus with a skeletal driver. The 'request stop for the invisible' mechanic is ours and distinct from MW011 (memory passengers).
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Each time Ivy presses STOP, the bus halts at an empty shelter and sinks as if someone boarded. The driver thanks her for ringing for 'them', who can't reach the button any more. At her own stop, someone else rings it for her.

hooks.line: Every time I press stop, the bus gets heavier.
hooks.first_visual: A red STOP button lit under a gloved thumb; an empty shelter in sodium rain ahead.

hooks.line: Nobody got on. The bus sank anyway.
hooks.first_visual: Bus suspension dipping at an empty stop.
A driver's eyes in the mirror.

hooks.line: Every empty stop, another seat dents.
hooks.first_visual: Seat cushions compressing one after another.

hooks.line: My stop came. I couldn't press the button.
hooks.first_visual: A grey hand resting over a woman's wrist.

setting: Night bus No. 9 interior and its rain-lit shelters.
conflict: Ivy wants to get home, but every press brings another invisible passenger.
escalation: Dips, dented seats, the driver's line, every seat full.
reveal: The bus is full of invisible passengers she rang for.
